_comment: Hand-authored misconceptionTags, keyed by the item's exact stem. Applied by tools/apply-authored-tags.mjs to every lesson carrying that stem (base + small-group variants). Use this file only where the error is unambiguous on inspection and the numeric derivation in tools/lib/operand-misconception-tagger.mjs cannot reach it — here, decomposition items whose choices are arithmetic EXPRESSIONS rather than single values, so no single quantity can be parsed and compared. Every entry below is the same defect: a part of the decomposition carries the right digits at the wrong place value (8.05 or 5 where 8.5 or 0.5 belongs, 7 where 70 belongs). null means no tag: an arithmetic slip or an operation swap the taxonomy has no honest name for is left undiagnosed on purpose.
